name: experience-layer-phase-2-playbook-lifecycle
title: Experience Layer Phase 2: staged Process Playbook lifecycle (propose/diff/approve/reject) with decision-doc digest integrity, lineage, and human-approved candidates — never auto-files findings or touches gates
description: Implement Phase 2 from docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md: a staged playbook lifecycle in handlers/playbook.ts (playbook_propose --finding, playbook_diff, playbook_approve, playbook_reject) backed by .lattice/learning/playbooks.json + proposals/<id>.json in learning-store. Proposals carry lineage (sourceStoryId/sourceFindingId/sourceSignature) and a proposalDigest computed via digestCanonicalJson from the leaf core/digest.js (B-2ccc); approve requires a matching expectedProposalDigest (stale fails closed, cloning the decision-doc pattern) and produces a candidate playbook (active requires explicit human approval, not auto-set). Hard guardrails: a playbook never auto-calls finding_add or any gate; every playbook has lineage. Proven by a smoke covering the full propose->diff->approve->reject lifecycle, digest fail-closed, lineage, the never-auto-finding guardrail, and no regression.
